items.title: SMO: Compiling Natural Language Skills into Graphs of Reusable State-Move-Outcome Bricks
items.summary: Large language model agents increasingly rely on reusable natural-language skills, yet growing skill collections remain accumulations of isolated text artifacts that are difficult to compare, deduplicate, and compose. We argue that the reusable content of a skill lies not in its surface wording but in its procedural transitions: which operation to execute under a given state and which observable outcome to produce. Based on this observation, we propose State-Move-Outcome (SMO), a compilation-like framework that decomposes raw skills into reusable procedural bricks and organizes admitted bricks as an externalized symbolic structure. When compiling a skill, SMO first retrieves and composes existing bricks, dynamically connects them through Outcome-to-State conditions, and creates a candidate brick only for an uncovered procedure; the candidate becomes reusable only after validation and admission. Experiments on SkillsBench v1.1 demonstrate that SMO represents 232 rawSkills from 87 underlying tasks with 95 shared bricks, reducing the corresponding skill representations from 366,472 to 149,154 tokens--a $\mathbf{59.3}\times$ reduction and $\mathbf{2.46}\times$ compression. Across 232 skill-conditioned evaluation instances, SMO raises the average task score from $\mathbf{0.6379}$ to $\mathbf{0.7478}$ and increases 5/5 Pass instances from $\mathbf{138}$ to $\mathbf{164}$, while matching or outperforming rawSkill on $\mathbf{208}$ of $\mathbf{232}$ instances. It also reduces average runtime token consumption by $\mathbf{38.38\%}$. These results show that compiling natural-language skills into shared procedural units can jointly improve skill reuse, representation efficiency, and downstream execution.

items.summary:
Miller 用一套流程，一个人做出角色会开口的 AI 短剧：一集 5 分钟，视频这一步大约 27 元。同样的量，用 Seedance 2.5 按火山方舟官方示例价，大约 1,360 元。

编剧和分镜用 Claude（或 DeepSeek），人物和场景图用 GPT Image、即梦或 Nano Banana，在 RunningHub 上用 MiniMax H3 一次出画面和台词，最后用剪映成片。人只做制片：定故事、挑镜头、拍板。

1. 成本怎么算

一集按约 50 段、一段平均 6 秒、每段抽 3 次，大约 150 次生成、15,000 RH币，合 27 元出头，一段大约 2 毛。文中 RunningHub 专业版当时限时 99 元/月，按这个算法大约能做 3 集半。价格以当时页面准，平台会调价。

2. 顺序先锁演员

先出角色身份板（全身、正面、白底，把鞋子写上），每段都喂进去。一段只喂一张场景图。台词要分成「评」「内心独白」「画外音」，避免角色把心里话念出来。声音描述写死，或把第一段满意的声音剪出来当参考；5 秒片段放一两句词。

3. 抽卡和穿帮

工作流的 seed 是固定的，想换一版要改数字。先跑 5 秒预览，满意再出长镜头。穿帮先剪头尾，中间出问题就截帧修好再按首尾帧补，最后才重抽。提示词里不要背景音乐，配乐留到剪映统一加。字幕也别让模型画，到剪映里识别后再对剧本。

文中附 8 段可复制提示词，还有光影速查 https://t.co/9CrX4yvkB5 和短剧技能包 https://t.co/YIQBmpHbQY 。新手路线是先做 10 秒：一句台词、角色和场景各一张图，用签到币试跑 5 秒预览。

https://t.co/XPMTYXQfAf
